title: The Man of God from Judah and King Jeroboam
description: A man of God from Judah came to Bethel and prophesied that a son named Josiah would be born in the house of David, who would sacrifice the priests of the high places on the altar. King Jeroboam reached out his hand to seize him, but his hand withered, and the altar split as a sign. After the man of God prayed for the king and his hand was healed, he refused to eat or drink in Bethel and returned home by another route.
